summary: Verified 7.2/10. Not on par: there is no blocker, but the score is under 7.5. The build is the same as at closing2: marund.glb sha 9a520cd7b7, last content change b4cf39106, and the GF-1 re-grade was reverted in 89112e613. Cards and portraits are dated Nov 4-5. Two majors are confirmed. (1) All six cards are brush-filtered renders: blocky smeared facets, a figure pasted onto the plate, base and Long Evening in one lean-on-maul pose, and Gorgewalk floating over a hard shadow line. The base portrait (512 px) hides the eyes under the rim and has a flat white wedge at the right. I viewed these myself. (2) In the attack2 hit frame the maul head is at his boot, short of the dummy, while the mint ribbon is drawn on the dummy (closing_marund_c3_swing_attack2_crop.png against attack1_crop). Both attacks fire the same [62,-58,14] arc. The probe's 'glint 1.146 m from the left fist' line is a heuristic artifact for a two-handed maul, since attack1 passes at 1.29 m, so the screenshot is the real evidence. I downgraded the new floor-penetration finding to minor. The clip_floor numbers stand on the current GLB, and the reviewer left out cast_a1 at 14 cm. But the burials last a few frames in fast casts and dashes at the top-down camera, the ult burial is an authored slam, and match idle passes at -0.011 m. Its weight is about one minor. Sensitivity is clean: the cap is a low flat disc, the carved stern mask has a beard and moustache, and Gorgewalk's white slabs read as tusks, not horror. Wicks are not in scope. Timing was not measured.

findings.title: Splash, portrait and skin cards are brush-filtered renders; base and Long Evening share one pose; Gorgewalk floats; base portrait hides the eyes
findings.what: All six cards are 3D renders run through a posterise/brush filter. The faces break into smeared facets, and the figure is lit flat and warm against a softer plate, so it looks pasted on. Base and Long Evening share the lean-on-maul pose. The Gorgewalk crouch hovers on a hard horizontal shadow line. The base portrait shows no eyes under the rim and has a flat white wedge to the right of the mask.
findings.evidence: art/out/fighters/marund/splash.png, marund_long_evening_splash.png, marund_gorgewalk_splash.png, portrait.png (mtimes Nov 4-5). The verifier viewed each one directly (downscaled copies in the scratchpad).
findings.gauge: LoL ships hand-painted splashes with a distinct story pose per skin, a grounded figure and a readable face at loading-screen size. VALE ships filtered renders.
findings.fix: Paint over in VALE's own lacquer-and-chalk style, from beauty/ID/light passes. Stage base as the Shelter Dome plant. Add contact shadows and rim light matched to each plate. Re-frame the base portrait so the eye recesses clear the rim's shadow.
findings.verifierNote: Reproduced by direct viewing. The severity holds: this is the first-impression art in the loading screen and collection, and its gap to the gauge is the largest on this fighter.

findings.title: The maul head dips below the floor plane in 13 of 16 clips
findings.what: The numbers reproduce on the current GLB: cast_a3 -0.201 m, channel -0.197, dash -0.165, idle_lobby -0.155, cast_a1 -0.140 (the reviewer left this one out), stunned -0.078, attack1 -0.082, recall -0.058, cast_ult -0.324 and domefall_leap -0.364 (both authored slams). Run is -0.026 m, which is a foot, not the prop. The min-y value is the lowest corner of a tilted 24 cm block, so much of the head stays above the ground. In match the dips last a few frames inside fast casts and dashes, seen top-down at about 50 px/m. The sustained match clip, idle, passes.
findings.evidence: _harness/_reports/closing_marund_c3_clipfloor.txt. _harness/_shots/closing_marund_c3_clips_a3_ult_channel.png is a crop of the stale Nov 3 sheet, so treat it only as illustration.
findings.gauge: LoL heavy weapons mostly meet the ground with a contact beat. Brief partial clips in fast casts are common there too, so this is a polish gap, not a major one.
findings.fix: Add a prop floor clamp in the clip bake (lowest maul vertex at y >= -0.02 m), and give idle_lobby, channel and cast_a3 contact frames. Cap the Domefall burial at about 6 cm and add a crack decal. Gate the build with clip_floor.py --limit -0.02.
findings.verifierNote: The measurement is confirmed, but the severity is overstated. Most of the dips are transient, the deepest ones are authored slams, and the clip most seen at close range (idle_lobby) dips only at f100. Downgraded to minor.

findings.title: attack2 does not connect at the hit frame; both attacks fire the identical ribbon arc
findings.what: At the attack2 hit capture the maul head hangs at his boot, outside the orange target ring, while the swing ribbon is drawn on the dummy. In attack1 the head is on the dummy. Both attacks use the arc [62,-58,14].
findings.evidence: _harness/_shots/closing_marund_c3_swing_attack2_crop.png against closing_marund_c3_swing_attack1_crop.png. _harness/_reports/closing_marund_c3_swing_clip_marund.json (arcs, plus attack2 glint y 0.80 against attack1 1.43). Note that the probe's 'glint 1.146 m from the left fist' FAIL is a one-handed heuristic: attack1 sits 1.29 m away and passes. Base the finding on the frame and the arc, not that line.
findings.gauge: In LoL every auto-attack variant lands the weapon on the target at its hit frame, with a trail along its own path.
findings.fix: Re-time attack2 so the head crosses the facing axis about 1.2 m out at knee height on the impact frame. Add an attack2 clip layer to marund_atk_swing with VALE's own low right-to-left sweep arc.
findings.verifierNote: Confirmed from the frames. An auto-attack seen every second in combat that visibly misses is a major.
